title: Lot C, iv
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday. Lot C from above: the Datsun alone at the far end, the guard's booth, the building far off. The strip's first overhead. He is exactly where he says he is.

panels.composition: Lot C from above in rain: painted lines, forty empty spaces, one rusted car at the far corner. The booth. The building a long way off.

balloons.text: (thinks) It's not far. It's just far enough.
